discover.description: Clarify the problem, user, evidence, and scope.

specify.description: Turn intent into behavior, acceptance criteria, and plans.

design.description: Shape system, API, data, integration, and visual boundaries.

verify.description: Test, diagnose, and secure a change.

release.description: Move work through isolation, commits, and pull requests.

maintain.description: Keep history, documentation, and repository governance healthy.

extend-skills.description: Author, audit, generate, and distribute skills.

configure-codex.description: Inspect Codex context and control-plane behavior.

orchestrate.description: Coordinate delegated work and usage limits.

skills.name: acceptance-criteria
skills.primary_trigger: Turn ambiguous requirements into observable pass/fail acceptance criteria.

skills.name: api-design
skills.primary_trigger: Design or review API contracts, schemas, errors, authorization, pagination, idempotency, and versioning.

skills.name: architecture
skills.primary_trigger: Create or evaluate architecture decisions and system designs with constraints, alternatives, and trade-offs.

skills.name: brainstorming-ux-features
skills.primary_trigger: Discover, evaluate, prioritize, and specify UX-focused product features from repository and user evidence.

skills.name: changelog-updater

skills.primary_trigger: Reconstruct or update user-facing changelogs from Git history and diffs.

skills.name: context-doctor
skills.primary_trigger: Audit Codex context loading and control-plane configuration; propose, but do not apply, changes.

skills.name: context7-skill-wizard
destructive_actions: writes generated skill files when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Use for “build a skill for” or “generate a skill from docs” requests naming a technology.

skills.name: data-modeling
skills.primary_trigger: Design or review durable data models, relationships, constraints, indexes, lifecycle, and concurrency assumptions.

skills.name: database-migrations
destructive_actions: may change persistent schema or data when explicitly requested
skills.primary_trigger: Plan, implement, or review safe persistent schema changes, backfills, compatibility windows, verification, and rollback.

skills.name: design-md-ideator
destructive_actions: writes DESIGN.md when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Create, refine, reconstruct, or validate a DESIGN.md design-system source of truth.

skills.name: efficient-frontier

skills.name: feature-implementation

skills.name: generate-codeowners
destructive_actions: writes CODEOWNERS only when explicitly requested
skills.primary_trigger: Generate or audit CODEOWNERS using verified repository and GitHub ownership evidence.

skills.name: generating-readmes
destructive_actions: writes README.md when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Generate, improve, audit, or verify a repository README or maintainer guide.

skills.name: git-commit
destructive_actions: creates Git commits
skills.primary_trigger: Explicitly request a Git commit or Conventional Commit message.

skills.name: git-workflow
destructive_actions: stages, commits, pushes, deletes, merges, or rebases when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Any requested Git action, including status inspection or synchronization.

skills.name: github-issue-to-pr

skills.name: grilling
skills.primary_trigger: Request a new interactive plan or design stress-test.

skills.name: imagegen
destructive_actions: writes generated image assets when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Request a new bitmap image or edit to an attached/generated image.

skills.name: improve
skills.primary_trigger: Audit a repository for improvement opportunities or prepare an evidence-backed handoff.

skills.name: integration-engineering
destructive_actions: changes external-service integration behavior when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Product behavior depends on a third-party API, SDK, webhook, OAuth provider, or service.

skills.name: intent-layer
destructive_actions: writes AGENTS.md files when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Initialize or add AGENTS.md context infrastructure to a codebase.

skills.name: last30days
destructive_actions: may save generated research briefs when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Request current public sentiment, trend research, or a shareable briefing.

skills.name: maintaining-repository-hygiene

skills.primary_trigger: Request repository hygiene, cleanup, governance, or professionalization work.

skills.name: mvp-scope

skills.name: pr-review
destructive_actions: may post a review when explicitly requested

skills.name: product-discovery
skills.primary_trigger: Use first when the product problem, user, or outcome is still unclear.

skills.name: product-spec
skills.primary_trigger: Write a detailed feature specification after product intent is understood.

skills.name: read-the-damn-docs
skills.primary_trigger: Implement, integrate, upgrade, debug, or answer a question involving a third-party technology.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.primary_trigger: Request review of uncommitted changes, a base diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

skills.name: security-best-practices

skills.name: simplification-cascades

skills.name: skill-installer

skills.name: stack-detection
skills.primary_trigger: Plan architectural or client-layer changes in a desktop application.

skills.name: stay-within-limits
skills.primary_trigger: Long-running or parallel agent work must respect usage windows.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.primary_trigger: Encounter a bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior.

skills.name: tailwind-design-system
destructive_actions: writes design-system code when requested
skills.primary_trigger: Build or extend a Tailwind CSS design system.

skills.name: taste-engine
